scope: Authenticated employee Investigation conversation, answer/planner and durable Objective memory

cases.oracle: The actual model request includes the earlier source and latest correction through the current accepted sequence.
Persist 30 user and assistant exchanges; recall early and middle requirements and exact artifact identifiers through real handler and model input.
At least three committed compactions preserve source-backed constraints and corrections; final answer uses the corrected value.
Original source is retrieved for a paraphrased reference after a topic switch.
Time ordering and distinct facts across source messages are interpreted correctly.
No invented fact or verified effect follows from missing source or assistant claims.
Other employees and tenants cannot read or bind private messages, summaries or retrieval results.
Earlier request excludes a later concurrently submitted turn.
Duplicate, stale and interrupted publication cannot regress coverage or lose durable original messages.
Fresh worker loads only the accepted Work-input conversation, independent of later chat; current authority stays separate.
Whole request fits the declared minimum fallback capacity; newest exchange and mandatory fields survive; impossible fit is explicit.
Old transcripts remain usable, migration rerun is idempotent, and legacy Work inputs cannot acquire unrelated memory.

rerunRule: Retain original failures; rerun only affected cases after a concrete source/fixture repair. Limits never relax a required predicate.
evidence: Each run records exact source hashes, inputs, expected observations, HTTP/DB/queue/model steps, checkpoints and source coverage, output, failures and rerun command. Deterministic provider transport is not model-quality evidence.
